shared_elements: standing human figures in long draped robes shown in profile
carved drapery rendered as regular parallel folds
low-relief figures aligned in a horizontal register/procession
legs and feet emerging beneath a long garment
justification: Both surfaces show shallow-relief processional figures in long pleated robes with the same conventions for stacked drapery folds, feet emerging below the hem, and hands grasping objects including a curved bow-like implement, which is a fairly specific shared scheme. The main difference is that B preserves only the lower body of one figure plus a subsidiary band of rosettes beneath it, while A shows complete upper bodies with distinctive bearded heads and tall headdresses and an interaction (one figure touching another's shoulder) that has no counterpart in B.
